theorems.status: PROVED elementary finite Fourier; asymptotic requires established PNT
theorems.statement: C_X(N) >= 2 S_X(0)^2/(3πX) >= W² X/(6π) for sufficiently large X, uniformly N∈[X/2,X], with fixed w≥0 in C_c^∞((0,1)); no positivity of full r_X(N) inferred.
0≤G_X(N)-r_X(N)≤2M² floor(sqrt X)(log X)² for every integer N and X≥4.

theorems.status: PROVED via established external classical Chebyshev prime-counting upper bound
theorems.statement: 0≤G_X(N)-r_X(N)≤4C_Ch M² sqrt X log X, X≥16, all integer N; C_Ch any valid uniform Chebyshev constant π(y)≤C_Ch y/log y, y≥2.
E_X(N)>−W²X/(6π), or G_X(N)>4C_Ch M² sqrt X log X, would imply genuine positive weighted prime coefficient r_X(N). Neither estimated independently for every residual N.

executed_exact_validation.focus: Reflected lookup versus independent direct pair-list convolution, proper-power contamination union bound, exact target matching deletion
executed_exact_validation.surrogate: w_X(t) = t(1−t) for t in (0,1), unit weights not actual log p. The surrogate does NOT satisfy w∈C_c^∞((0,1)) and is deliberately used ONLY for finite algebra checks.
executed_exact_validation.limitations: Neither the sinc central-core integral nor PNT/Chebyshev theorem constants were numerically tested; mathematical proofs and known literature supply those facts.

caveats: Core integral can be cancelled exactly by signed contribution outside core; the complement includes rational major arcs.
Adversarial deletion of true-prime subset is not the immutable full true-prime polynomial and does not refute Goldbach.
Power corrections do not yield a positive lower bound for G_X(N).
Finite 122 exact tests do not verify the asymptotic analytic results or Goldbach.
No peer review, Lean proof, CoCalc/Codex computation, PR merge or scheduled automation.
